stories.title: Vikings 'hyped' to welcome back 'leader' Cousins on 1st day of practice
stories.summary: The Minnesota Vikings reveled Thursday in quarterback Kirk Cousins' first full day back with the organization.
stories.detail: EAGAN, Minn. -- The Minnesota Vikings reveled Thursday in quarterback Kirk Cousins ' first full day back with the organization. Their operations staff opened practice by playing Creed's "Higher" on the team's outdoor speakers, drawing knowing smirks from the handful of players and coaches who remember it as Cousins' anthem during the 2023 season. "It got me hyped," right tackle Brian O'Neill said. "It felt like it raised the temperature outside a few degrees." Rookie safety Jakobe Thomas gave up his No. 8 free of charge, saying afterward that "I just want him to come help us win games." And receiver Justin Jefferson described the day as "a joy to hear him just take over and be a leader in the meeting room, on the field." The Vikings acquired Cousins from the Las Vegas Raiders hours before Tuesday's trade deadline, in exchange for a 2027 third-round pick. He spent Wednesday meeting with coach Kevin O'Connell and other members of the staff, but O'Connell did not hold a practice so that players could have an additional recovery day following their 23-6 loss Monday night to the Buffalo Bills . stories.title: Rams put WR Puka Nacua on IR with knee, toe injuries
stories.summary: The Rams, who had said they would not put Puka Nacua on IR, pivoted so they can sign Brennan Presley to the active roster and Tyler Scott to the practice squad.
stories.detail: LOS ANGELES -- The Rams put wide receiver Puka Nacua on injured reserve after all Thursday. Nacua injured the MCL in his right knee and a toe in Sunday's victory over the Washington Commanders and is expected to sit out what coach Sean McVay called "an extended period of time." On Wednesday, McVay had said that because of roster mechanics, the Rams would keep Nacua on the active roster. But on Thursday, the Rams pivoted so they can sign receiver Brennan Presley to the active roster and sign receiver Tyler Scott to the practice squad. Nacua will sit out at least four games while on injured reserve, at the Arizona Cardinals , at home against the Green Bay Packers and Kansas City Chiefs , and at the San Francisco 49ers . In seven games this season, Nacua has 70 catches for 715 yards and four touchdowns. He sat out Weeks 2 and 3 because of a hip injury. Nacua's 70 receptions are the most through a player's first seven games of a season in NFL history, according to ESPN Research. The Rams (5-4) also are without wide receiver Davante Adams , who has been on injured reserve since rupturing a hamstring muscle late in the Rams' Week 6 loss to the Cardinals.

Nacua was injured last Sunday on the Rams’ final play of their 20-13 victory over the Washington Commanders . stories.detail: (Photo by Brooke Sutton/Getty Images) | Getty Images We saw the Washington Commanders keep things close against the San Francisco 49ers about a month ago. We’ll see them travel to New York to take on the Giants at the beginning of December. Both NFC East foes go head-to-head to kick things off in Week 10. The Giants have a surprising lead in the NFC East. They’re 5-2-1, but have a point differential of only +10. J.J. McCarthy will be the quarterback leading the G-Men to the postseason if they can make it that far. I’m not so sure the Giants will win tonight. Thursday games can be wonky. Underdogs have been barking all year in this spot. It does not seem like a good spot for the Giants; they only outgained Joe Milton and the Eagles last week by 23 yards. Their defense has performed well. The cornerbacks have been a pleasant surprise, and Arvell Reese is living up to his draft status as a rookie. Washington has the significantly better quarterback here, and that might be enough to make a difference.

stories.title: Rams place WR Puka Nacua on IR
stories.summary: Nacua injured the MCL and PCL in his knee and has turf toe.
stories.detail: A day after Sean McVay said the Rams wouldn’t place Puka Nacua on injured reserve, the wide receiver went on IR. McVay said “roster semantics” would keep Nacua on the 53-man roster, with every team getting only eight designated-to-return slots during the season. The Rams have used three of their designations and have Kobie Turner, Davante Adams, Terrance Ferguson and now Nacua on IR with hopes of returning. But with Nacua set to miss "extended time," as McVay said Wednesday, with MCL and PCL sprains in his knee and turf toe, the Rams opted to move him to the IR list. Nacua will miss at least the next four games, with the Cowboys game on Dec. 20 the earliest he can return by rule. The Rams signed wide receiver Brennan Presley to take Nacua's roster spot and added wide receiver Tyler Scott to the practice squad.

stories.summary: The NBA on Thursday suspended Rockets guard Marcus Smart three games without pay for throwing a punch at Warriors center Charles Bassey.
stories.detail: The NBA on Thursday suspended Houston Rockets guard Marcus Smart three games without pay for throwing a punch at Golden State Warriors center Charles Bassey . Smart grazed Bassey's nose with a right hook during a confrontation late in the third quarter of Houston's 115-108 home win Wednesday night. Smart was assessed a flagrant foul 2 and ejected . Smart will miss games Friday at home against the Utah Jazz , Sunday at the Washington Wizards and Monday at the Miami Heat . The 12-year veteran joined Houston over the summer in free agency, and is averaging 8.6 points, 2.6 rebounds and 1.1 steals over nine games with one start. The Rockets are 9-3 and in third place in the Western Conference entering play Thursday. Smart and Bassey engaged in the third quarter Wednesday night after Rockets guard Amen Thompson barreled to the rim for a transition bucket that extended Houston's lead with 21 seconds left. In the aftermath of the play, Smart and Bassey stood face to face jawing as Warriors forward Yaxel Lendeborg attempted to separate them. Smart threw a right hook that grazed Bassey's nose as he stepped back to slip the punch. The incident took place in front of referee Mitchell Ervin. T…

In the East, the new-look Philadelphia 76ers seem like they've been playing together for years, as LeBron James and Jaylen Brown have hit the ground running with their new teammates. They're tailed tightly by their offseason trade partners, the Boston Celtics , who seemingly haven't missed a beat with new faces around Jayson Tatum . In this week's Power Rankings, our ESPN insiders rank where each team stands, per usual, and also highlight each team's best newcomer over the first few weeks of the season.
